name: After § 76
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 76a. Underlines the need to enhance our partnerships with like-minded countries, particularly those in Europe, such as the UK and Norway; calls for a broad EU-UK security pact, also covering key subjects such as energy, migration and critical minerals; points to the added value of fostering our relationships with global partners such as the US, Japan and Australia;
